description: Four original rosters for a four-coach league: one sound, one functional but flawed, one deliberately incoherent, one underspent. The flaw field is tester-facing; coaches never see it.

teams.name: Harbour Lights
teams.flaw: none: a sound rain roster with three megas; a coach with nothing to fix should usually stand pat

teams.name: Clockwork Gap
teams.flaw: no mega: a functional balance roster that never spent its mega slot

teams.name: Four Seasons Buffet
teams.flaw: no synergy: sun, sand, snow and rain setters, one mega, no abuser and a one-point filler

teams.name: Bargain Bin
teams.flaw: unspent budget: 21 points idle behind three one-point fillers
